_doc.purpose: Book NSpace mapping table — IRS form fid → Income-Statement Acct UAS path.
_doc.format: [ 'F###', '<Acct UAS>' ]   3-digit zero-padded fid; UAS is either a single COA acct (e.g. 'Acct.Rev.Rent') or a stmtIncomeStmt taxAggregate name prefixed 'IS.' (e.g. 'IS.net_income').
_doc.scope: Only fields that are sourced from the Income Statement appear here.  Profile-sourced and Balance-Sheet-sourced fields live in bookNS_Profile.json / bookNS_BS.json.  A single Acct may appear under multiple fids (e.g. Acct.Rev.Rent → F030,F032,F034,F230).
_doc.resolver: irsForm.savePDF() resolves each entry as follows:  acct startswith 'Acct.' → stmtIncomeStmt row Balance for that COA acct;  acct startswith 'IS.'   → stmtIncomeStmt.taxAggregates()[name];  acct startswith 'Profile.' → stmtProfile cell;  acct startswith 'BS.'   → stmtBalanceSheet.taxAggregates()[name].
_doc.perPartner: Sch_K1 entries are partnership-level totals.  irsForm.savePDF() multiplies them by partner.pct from llcOwners when emitting per-partner FILL pdfs.

_Sch_K1_note: Runtime values are provided by stmtIS_TaxMember._build_k1_filldict() which multiplies by partner.pct and keys by namespace fid directly. Entries above are documentation-only; they are NOT resolved by stmtIS_Tax.loadFillDict() at runtime.

_Form8825_doc.runtime: Form8825 is NOT resolved via this static bookNS. stmtIS_Tax.loadFillDict('Form8825') calls _build_f8825_filldict() which builds the fill dict dynamically from GL records grouped by propNm. This section is DOCUMENTATION ONLY.
_Form8825_doc.cip_rule: CIP properties (Acct.Fixed.Tangible.InConstruction, no placed-in-service date) are excluded from Form 8825 entirely. IRC §168(a): MACRS starts at placed-in-service. Pre-service expenses must be capitalized (IRC §263(a)), not reported on Form 8825.

RV_RV1_2025.status: InConstruction — Bill of Sale 2025-12-29. Not placed in service.
RV_RV1_2025.form_8825_column: NONE — excluded. No income, no expenses, no depreciation on Form 8825.
RV_RV1_2025.pre_service_expenses: Acct.Exp.Repair + Acct.Exp.Other entries for RV_RV1 (~$1,075) MUST be reclassified to Acct.Fixed.Tangible.InConstruction. IRC §263(a): capitalize all pre-placed-in-service costs.
RV_RV1_2025.irc_authority: IRC §168(a) (no depr until in service); IRC §263(a) (capitalize construction costs); Reg. §1.263(a)-2(a)
